objectives: 教導學生明瞭固體力學之基本知識及線性彈性力學所呈現之物理現象；傳授學生分析線彈性材料受外力加載後變形與應力的方法與技巧，期使學生能將所學的知識應用於解釋與解決與固體力學相關的課題。
content:
(1)	Index Notation and Tensor Analysis
(2)	Stress Tensor and Equilibrium Equations
(3)	Deformation and Strain
(4)	Constitutive Equations and Material Symmetry
(5)	Linearized Theory of Elasticity
(6)	One-Dimensional Problems
(7)	Two-Dimensional Problems
(8)	Torsion Problems
(9)	Bending Problems
(10)	Plate Problems
books:
Text books:

Reismann, H., Elastic plates Theory and application, New York Wiley, 1988.

Sadd, M. H., Elasticity : Theory, Application, and Numerics 4th edition, Elsevier, 2020.

Reference:

Fung, Y. C., Foundations of Solid Mechanics, Prentice-Hall, 1969.

Atkin and Fox, An Introduction to the Theory of Elasticity, Longman, 1980.

Timoshenko, S.P. and Goodier, J.N., Theory of Elasticity, McGraw-Hill, 1982.

Fung, Y. C. and Tong, Pin, Classical and Computational Solid Mechanics, World Scientific, 2001.
grading_policy:
30％ 期中考
30％ 期末考
30％ 作業
10％ 課堂表現
